Message:
Before I knew it,
the house fell silent once more.
I quietly called out to
my mother and sisters.

“Lillicotte...? Good...
It seems...casting that
protective charm on
the door...worked...”

I could see Mother’s brooch
through the keyhole.

But, when I tried to
call her name,
my lips wouldn’t move...

I heard a drip fall,
then saw a pool of something
slowly seep in from
under the door...

“I can still remember the day
you were born...so clearly...

Wondering just what
kind of witch...
you would one day become...”

Mother, open the door...!
Your wounds
need tending, quickly...!!

“But, such thoughts...
weren’t what truly mattered...
I’m so sorry, Lillicotte...”
Enough of that, just hurry and—!!

Even if I can’t
remember your voice...
I’ll always remember
what you truly felt...!

I leaned against the door
to be closer to her...
